attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Major version bump of the Elasticsearch client (8→9) removes the 'language' analyzer support and changes core API surface (GetMappingAsync/GetAsync/DynamicTemplates), which can break existing indexes, custom analyzers configured as 'language', and any downstream modules using ElasticsearchConstants.LanguageAnalyzer or the changed IndexManager APIs, with no migration path evident and likely requiring compatible Elasticsearch server v9."}
